recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless OO explicitly wants a more specific RelatedPerson caregiver example in addition to the current subject-general guidance.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO issue asking what Observation.subject plus Observation.focus=RelatedPerson means, resolving to update Observation.focus guidance with a caregiver use case and make Observation.focus a modifier.
initial_application: Git history shows 7a5dceb8125349335cb7532470282bc4b609f368 applied the issue by adding caregiver wording, isModifier=true, an isModifierReason, and a FiveWs mapping exception for Observation.focus.

Confluence minutes confirm this subject/focus split and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current Observation source is already correct. Re-adding the exact older back-strain sentence would be redundant and would partially undo the later FHIR-43357 cleanup.
